evidence.quote: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 1-3/4 to 2 percent
will act as appropriate to sustain the expansion, with a strong labor market and inflation near its symmetric 2 percent objective
On a 12-month basis, overall inflation and inflation for items other than food and energy are running below 2 percent.
Although household spending has been rising at a strong pace, business fixed investment and exports have weakened.
In light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures
